prompts.title: A — Collection in everyday browsing
prompts.text: Show Card Library as one complete screen, 6 full large cards across, compact filters in the existing top rows. Add a discreet segmented ownership control labelled 'All cards', 'Owned', 'Unowned'; 'Owned' selected. Place an 'Edit my collection' button near it. Keep 'Entire catalogue' / 'Playable now' controls visibly separate from ownership. Under each card put readable 'Owned: 3', 'Owned: 1', 'Owned: 2', 'Owned: 4', 'Owned: 1', 'Owned: 3' captions, no plus/minus during ordinary browsing. Selected Crane and Mantis clan medallions persist. Card size slider clearly visible in upper right. Header 'CARD LIBRARY'. Footer 'Your collection · Saved on this device'. Distinguish collection ownership from engine support: one owned card also shows a quiet 'Not yet playable' caption. Make the new controls feel naturally folded into the reference interface and preserve generous breathing room. No deck quantities on Library.

prompts.title: B — Focused collection editor
prompts.text: Show a focused large centered lacquer overlay titled 'EDIT MY COLLECTION' above the existing dimmed Library. One overlay, not separate account/inventory software. Top row 'Import CSV', 'Export CSV', 'Done' with restrained gold emphasis. Subtitle 'Changes save automatically on this device'. Compact search field and a context row 'All cards' / 'Owned' / 'Unowned'. Show 4 full card faces at generous size with a plainly labelled quantity editor UNDER each: 'Owned' followed by minus, editable numeric box, plus. Values 3, 1, 0, 2. One card zero labelled 'Not owned'. Counts are editable with numeric input; card click still inspect full card. A thin footer 'Undo last change'. Preserve navy cloth, gold lacquer frame, reference fonts; keep full faces intact. No In deck buttons here; no collection quantities represented by deck-building plus/minus. The focused edit mode is clearly visibly different from ordinary browsing without heavy ornament or dense side panels.

prompts.title: C — CSV review before applying
prompts.text: Show a single centered large readable lacquer import modal on dimmed Library. Header 'REVIEW COLLECTION IMPORT'. Subtitle 'my-cards.csv · Update listed cards'. Explain directly 'Listed counts replace your current totals. Unlisted cards stay unchanged.' A compact three-part progress line 'Choose file → Review changes → Apply', middle highlighted. Body clean table with columns 'Card', 'Current', 'Imported', 'Change'. Exactly 3 sample matched rows: 'Asahina Konomi' 1 3 '+2'; 'Asahina Nanae' 4 2 '−2'; 'Daidoji Kenshi' 0 1 '+1'. Small full card thumbnail per row, version names visible when relevant. Below an amber-accented unresolved row 'Asahina Keigo — choose a version', with two small full card previews explicitly 'Base' and 'Experienced'. The copy '1 unresolved row · Nothing has been saved yet' above bottom action row. Buttons 'Back', 'Cancel', and DISABLED 'Apply changes' (disabled pending unresolved choice). Secondary subtle link 'Download CSV template'. A clearly labelled mode control 'Update listed cards' and a quieter separate option 'Replace entire collection' so replacement cannot be confused with additive quantities. Repeated importing sets totals, does not add. Legible large typography and sparse information hierarchy, no warnings unrelated to import. Match reference UI while making operational data exceptionally readable.

prompts.title: D — Deck shortages without interrupting drafting
prompts.text: Show complete Deck Builder screen using existing reference layout: full card grid left, compact 'YOUR DECK' list right (about 27% width). Search, multi-select clans, filter row, Card size draggable slider remain. Collection control set 'All cards' so unowned cards remain browsable. Cards get simple caption 'Owned: 1' and below separately 'In deck' with minus 3 plus, another 'Owned: 0' below its full face and 'In deck' minus 1 plus, other cards owned3 deck2. The deck sidebar shows normal Dynasty40 Fate40 totals and save draft controls, plus an understated shortage status '3 copies missing · 2 cards'. Shortage rows: 'Asahina Konomi' with 'In deck: 3 · Owned: 1' and a small muted amber 'Need 2'; 'Daidoji Kenshi' with 'In deck: 1 · Owned: 0' and 'Need 1'. A discreet 'View missing cards' button and 'Export missing list' action. Keep ordinary deck plus/minus separate from read-only owned quantities. No compulsory purchase/store prompts. 'Save draft' enabled; small footer 'You can keep planning with cards you do not own'. Separate quiet existing game validation message from ownership status. Header 'DECK BUILDER'. Make shortage meaning obvious without colouring/covering card art or turning the right column into another dashboard.

Top row clearly add a separate control 'Collection: All cards ▾' with an 'Edit my collection' button. Keep 'Entire catalogue' and 'Playable now' separate from collection membership; do not replace engine support with ownership. Right sidebar standard rows retain minus and plus for every deck quantity even when short. Make the shortage summary exactly '3 copies missing · 2 cards' and exactly TWO shortage rows: Asahina Konomi, In deck 3 / Owned 1 / Need 2; Daidoji Kenshi, In deck 1 / Owned 0 / Need 1. Every other visible card has Owned >= In deck: Asahina Akahiko owned3 indeck3; Asahina Akiikusa owned3 indeck2; Asahina Keigo owned1 indeck1; Asahina Keigo Experienced owned3 indeck0; Asahina Kitiaru owned1 indeck0; Asahina Michiru owned2 indeck0; Asahina Nanae owned3 indeck3; Asahina Shigetsu owned2 indeck0. For Asahina Konomi make grid values match sidebar owned1 indeck3. Ensure no duplicated contradictory card totals. Footer simply 'Draft can be saved' and separate 'Ownership does not block drafting', no invented claim that the pictured draft has passed all rules checks. View missing cards / Export missing list retained. All card names/stats illustrative design mockup only.
